raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Summary

NIXL P/D with DCP finalized `cp_kv_cache_interleave_size` during connector initialization, after profiling. `SparseAttnIndexer` could therefore use a stale interleave while the final cache and transfer layouts used the resolved value, corrupting sparse indices.

- Resolve global KV-cache groups once after layout selection, publish the same groups to workers before profiling, and reuse them for allocation.
- Keep NIXL-specific resolution in `VllmConfig`; connector initialization no longer mutates configuration.
- Read the interleave directly from `ParallelConfig` instead of caching it in `SparseAttnIndexer`.
- Remove the duplicate `dcp_kv_cache_interleave_size` field while retaining `--dcp-kv-cache-interleave-size` as a CLI alias.

## Tests

```bash
VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
  tests/test_config.py::test_pd_dcp_interleave_size_is_adjusted_to_block_size \
  tests/test_config.py::test_kv_offloading_does_not_adjust_dcp_interleave_size \
  tests/v1/core/test_kv_cache_utils.py::test_get_kv_cache_configs_multiple_workers \
  tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_worker.py::test_resolved_layout_finalizes_nixl_dcp_interleave_before_profiling \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_kv_connector_lifecycle.py::test_kv_connector_mixin_clears_metadata
```

- `6 passed`.
- Verified the legacy CLI alias populates `cp_kv_cache_interleave_size`.
- End-to-end NIXL P/D + DCP validation completed without engine, CUDA, or transfer errors and confirmed finalization occurs before profiling and connector construction.

AI assistance was used to investigate the issue, prepare the patch and tests, and draft this description. I reviewed every changed line and ran the validations above.
